defects.title: run_smoke does NOT call _evaluate_frozen_system_proposal
defects.proof_method: AST call-graph extraction of the frozen v1.3 run_smoke function body
defects.consequence: The real learned-component PROPOSAL pipeline (B_phi re-decision + conditional R_psi + conditional S_omega on a perturbed geometry) is never exercised by smoke; only the geometry transform is.

defects.title: empty-proposal smoke does NOT call the real proposal evaluator
defects.proof_method: source-byte inspection of the v1.3 run_smoke empty-proposal block
defects.consequence: The frozen NOT_APPLICABLE_EMPTY_PROPOSAL contract (status, zero R_psi forwards, zero S_omega forwards, no replacement geometry) is asserted by constant, never executed.

defects.title: _smoke_state_machine checks B_phi SKIP/EXECUTE only
defects.proof_method: AST extraction of the v1.3 _smoke_state_machine case registry
defects.consequence: The EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT and EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT final branches are never branch-controlled in smoke.

defects.title: clean/image/proposal evaluators execute R_psi BEFORE the B_phi SKIP/EXECUTE decision whenever ROI exists
defects.proof_method: source-byte line ordering inside each v1.3 evaluator function
defects.consequence: Speculative pre-decision R_psi compute. On a true SKIP_GLOBAL sample the frozen state machine requires R_psi forwards = 0, but v1.3 has already run R_psi. The conditional-execution semantics of the frozen system are not reproduced.

defects.title: G numerical execution does not inherit the canonical Phase27 VAL808 numerical contract
defects.proof_method: source-byte inspection of every G forward call site in v1.3
defects.consequence: The clean G probability path in v1.3 is numerically different from the frozen Phase27 authority, so the §E bit-identical clean global reproduction gate could never have been satisfied.

defects.title: direct G calls create task-id tensors without binding them to the same device as the G model/input
defects.proof_method: regex enumeration of every torch.tensor([...task_id...]) construction in v1.3

evidence.note: The only device-bound task-id tensor in v1.3 is inside _smoke_state_machine._router_score, not in any G call.

defects.consequence: CPU task-id tensor passed to a CUDA G forward; device mismatch.

defects.title: clean route equivalence compares only global-vs-nonglobal, not exact state_machine_branch
defects.proof_method: source-byte inspection of the v1.3 _clean_equivalence_gate comparator
defects.consequence: EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT and EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT are collapsed into one 'non-global' class, so a REJECT that should be ACCEPT (or vice versa) passes the gate.

defects.title: router_decision is populated from final state rather than the actual B_phi SKIP/EXECUTE decision
defects.proof_method: source-byte inspection of every router_decision assignment in v1.3
defects.consequence: router_decision ∈ {FORCED_SKIP, SKIP_GLOBAL, EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT, EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT} instead of the required {SKIP, EXECUTE}. The B_phi decision is not separable from the final state.

defects.title: KUB 'subgroup' output is not actually subgrouped by the frozen Kidney/Bladder/Ureteric reporting metadata
defects.proof_method: source-byte inspection of the v1.3 kub_subgroup_robustness function (lines 1420-1431)
defects.consequence: The KUB table carries no subgroup labels and no per-subgroup robustness summary; the frozen reporting authority is unused.

defects.title: R1-R5 figure generation is absent from the Phase36 science path
defects.proof_method: AST function-definition enumeration and FIG-path usage scan of v1.3
defects.consequence: The frozen Phase36 figure registry R1-R5 is unimplemented and unreachable from run_science.
